name: Aura of Vitality

source.note: Not in the free 2024 Basic Rules; written from knowledge of the 2024 PHB and cross-checked against aidedd.org's 2024 entry.

summary: 30-foot Emanation: as a Bonus Action, one creature in it regains 2d6 HP.
text: Healing energy surrounds you in a 30-foot Emanation until the spell ends. Until then, you can take a Bonus Action to have one creature in the aura (yourself included) regain 2d6 Hit Points.

sustain.label: Aura of Vitality: heal
sustain.help: A Bonus Action: one creature in the aura (you included) regains 2d6 Hit Points.
